known_outcome: No project-specific permit decision or AHJ acceptance is reported for this illustrative catalogue example. The guide expressly disclaims use of the examples for approval.
review_focus: Keep the guide scenario separate from actual applicant, owner, civic address, survey, or permit facts.
Ask which current code edition/printing and acceptable-solution departure apply to the real proposal; verify any attributed objectives and functional statements from authoritative code sources.
Identify missing site-specific zoning, surveyed dimensions, occupancy, complete drawings and application requirements.
Identify the professional-authored alternative-solution report, risk assessment, mitigation measures, and assumptions/limits that need to be supplied or confirmed; do not write professional evidence.
Ask focused next questions and make no safety, compliance, or approval determination.
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
